scope: Independent exact symbolic reference calculation, explicit-index sample checks and diagnostic continuation. Does not execute the submitted noninteger-dimensional graph evaluator or prove its final finite value in Lean.

conventions.Ds: independent formal vector trace dimension; physical comparison Ds=D

published_check: Exact D-dependent total agrees with Grozin (2012), Eq. (84), nf=0, xi=1; finite coefficient 97/36 also agrees with Ruijl et al. (2017), App. A.1 after sign-convention conversion.

full_gluon_plus_ghost.tadpole: scaleless in conventional massless dimensional regularization

negative_control: Ds=4 retains the pole and transversality but loses the finite +1/3 contribution; full constant becomes 85/36.
limitations: Analytic master-integral formula and Laurent expansion are used, not proved in Lean.
Generic identification of the submitted continued cubic sewing with the independent tensor contraction remains open.
No proof here of the renormalized cutoff-graph infrared limit or conventional tadpole cancellation in the submitted evaluator.
Ds=4 is a diagnostic replacement only, not a claim of a fully specified alternate renormalization scheme.
